answer_1.quote: We also include a text generation model, GPT-2 (gpt2-xl) ... generate 70, 150, 300, and 700 words ... Generated stories are then parsed by Open-SESAME to extract the semantic frames and turned into frame representations as the predictions.
answer_1.outputs: Predicted frame representations (TF‑IDF vectors), visual word‑clouds of semantic frames, and generated story text (via GPT‑2).

answer_2.quote: We use Cosine Similarity between the predicted vector and the gold-standard vector (compiled from the human-written story block) for evaluation. Many other metrics, such as Mean‑Squared Error (MSE), also exist to measure the distance between two vectors.

answer_4.quote: We first visualize the vector of semantic frames into word clouds so that humans can perceive and comprehend it. We then use online crowd workers to test the (i) representativeness and (ii) the specificity of the produced word clouds.
answer_4.guideline: Workers read the follow‑up story block and select the word cloud that best represents it (representativeness); in another HIT they read two story blocks and choose which one is referred to by a given word cloud (specificity).
